description: This file contains integration tests for the UI configuration handlers of an agent management system. It includes mocked storage interactions and tests for retrieving configuration schemas, getting configurations, and setting configurations for agents via HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: setupTestRouter
methods.description: Initializes a Gin test router with route groups for config schema, get config, and set config handlers, using a mocked storage provider.

methods.name: TestGetConfigSchemaHandler
methods.description: Tests the HTTP GET endpoint for retrieving the configuration schema of an agent package, including success, missing parameters, package not found scenarios.

methods.name: TestGetConfigHandler
methods.description: Tests the HTTP GET endpoint for retrieving agent configuration. Includes cases for existing configuration, no configuration, and missing packageId.

methods.name: TestSetConfigHandler
methods.description: Tests the HTTP POST endpoint for setting (creating or updating) agent configuration, including success (create/update), validation failure, invalid JSON, and missing packageId scenarios.

methods.name: stringPtr
methods.description: Utility function to easily create a string pointer from a string literal.
